axes.name: Original obligations and negative constraints
axes.assessment: All original brief clauses and plan body clauses have independent dispositions. The final preserves synthetic context, open case variables, pre-purchase proposal scope, passive/route/measurement alternatives, mechanisms, history reconstruction and prospective pilot. It gives no current-shipment build/instructions, unsupported limit or invented route/crop/result. Actual forbidden-action history cannot be certified solely from artifacts. Original time-window execution is kept separate.

axes.name: Consequential source claims and applicability
axes.assessment: All stable S01–S11 identities and consequential source conditions were independently checked against governing primary publications or official institutional records. Initial cooling is separate from transport; air/core/quality are not equated; studies are bounded to their produce, operation, unit/type and context. PCM crate air is not pulp/quality, apple cooling is not universal simulator validation, evaporative surrogate results are not local product results, and cross-fruit/carton 42% is not an isolated packaging effect. No unknown logger default, product criterion, runtime, cost saving or safety threshold is adopted. One carried S04 load-condition unit detail is unsupported: 48 oranges is stated per comparison set, not per individual crate (L05); it drives no final load/capacity recommendation.

axes.name: Useful unfamiliar discovery, alternatives, implementation/history and opportunity breadth
axes.assessment: The pipeline finds concrete unfamiliar mechanisms and analogues: biomimetic artificial fruit, PCM alveoli for a short route, separate charging of a road–rail PCM container, evaporative crate/wet-fabric transport, and full-scale cooling heterogeneity. It compares these with unchanged-operation measurement, existing preconditioning/crate/airflow work and approved handling/timing/order/load-size tests. Published conditions, conditioning/reuse burdens and management history are investigated rather than replaced by generic caution. Local route/packing history cannot be researched without records; the proposal specifies those records and avoids causal recollection. Future failure/maintenance work is concrete but no local failure is invented.

axes.name: Wrong criticism/corrections/rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.assessment: C01–C04 are separately adjudicated, not accepted from critic authority. C01’s material severity is not independently established: no model is compulsory; final’s explicit future-model limits are useful and correct. C02 repairs a minor thermal/quality ambiguity. C03 is backed by the publisher’s exact fruit/carton contrast. C04 appropriately leaves necessary local choices open. Final does not reject supported capabilities or introduce a required experiment, deployment, generic threshold or scope reduction. Every brief and plan clause, including authoring/release provenance, is covered in the independent matrix.

axes.name: Supported discovery/draft/critique/final meaning preserved
axes.assessment: The final remains self-contained and retains the substantive conditional comparison, sensor alternative, specific implementation contexts, uncertainty, owner decisions, rejects and future pilot; it does not become a change log or predecessor-ID substitute. Later draft discoveries S09–S11 survive. Minor earlier wording/coverage defects remain documented as lineage and do not become final failures. Heat-mode/respiration exposition is compressed (L03), but no consequential causal estimate or decision depends on that missing detail. Carried S10 shorthand is offset by explicit final correction (L02).

axes.name: Meaningful proposed versus executed validation and oracle applicability
axes.assessment: Executed work is desk discovery/source checking and proposal writing. The final attributes predecessor activity and identifies its own S10 primary abstract check, access failure and absence of empirical/model work. Proposed validation has a representative unchanged-operation baseline, traceable lots/crates, synchronized exposed/in-crate/core-or-validated-simulator channels, logger metadata/checks, product-specific quality measurements, repeated matched/position-swapped comparisons, separate approved handling crossover and practical costs. Real product/quality measurements and crop/transition validation are applicable oracles; counts, sensor agreement, smoothed air traces, abstract quality claims and toy models are not. Sample size, endpoints/effect criterion and economics require baseline/owner input rather than invention.

This is a small loss of exposition, not an uninvestigated local conclusion.

limitations.description: S02 describes a current web record with no visible revision date; independently retrieved HTML includes publication/update metadata. S04 publisher notes distinguish original and updated PDFs, while candidate source identity uses DOI/year and repository PDF. These do not establish a scientific correction or changed governing condition.
limitations.why_not_material: The independently read governing passages support the claimed behavior and exceptions. No software default, numeric operating condition or source-specific product decision hinges on an unestablished revision.

limitations.description: The investigator and reviser source maps describe the PCM field setup as about 48 oranges per crate. The primary methods, section 2.2 (PDF p.5), state that each of the two comparison sets of crates was equally loaded with 48 oranges. That wording does not support assigning 48 to each individual crate. The independently recorded condition is 48 per comparison set.
limitations.why_not_material: The final prose gives no per-crate fruit count and imports no numeric thermal capacity, crate-loading rule or predicted benefit. Its proposed matched test uses the cooperative’s measured crop/lot, fill and starting state. This is an erroneous carried study-condition detail that should remain visible in the diagnostic, but it does not determine a consequential local choice.
